desc: Bring 6 Oils of Immolation, 5 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 10 Dense Blasting Powder to Arcanist Nozzlespring near Hive'Zora in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 6 Oils of Immolation, 5 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 10 Dense Blasting Powder to Arcanist Nozzlespring near Hive'Zora in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.
details: Bring 6 Oils of Immolation, 5 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 10 Dense Blasting Powder to Arcanist Nozzlespring near Hive'Zora in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.
progress: You have something for me, $N?
completion: Ah, yes!  These will come in handy! Much obliged, $N!

8802.name: The Savior of Kalimdor
desc: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.
objectives: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.
details: To the Caverns of Time you go, $G Lord:Lady; $N. Anachronos awaits your return. Give him the eye of C'Thun as he will undoubtedly wish to place it in his master's collection.$B
completion: The Master has left these for you, champion. From the timeless cache: A collection of artifacts spanning thousands of years - the choice is yours.
progress: Lord $N! It is over...

8826.name: Ten Commendation Signets
progress: I accept commendation signets from adventurers who have received them in the line of duty. For each set of ten that you hand to me, I'll make sure that you receive a significant acknowledgement of your deeds with the Darkspear tribe. I also accept single tokens, but at a much reduced rate of recognition. We are much more interested in greater feats of duty, though no feat will be ignored.$B$BWith that said, I'll gladly take your signets if you are ready to hand in a set.
completion: Excellent! It is no small sacrifice that you've made to earn these signets, and you will be acknowledged for your service appropriately. It's adventurers like you, $N, that truly make a difference.$B$BLet me know if you have additional signets to hand in; I'll gladly help you out with whatever ones you need exchanged.

8850.name: Thirty Signets for War Supplies
progress:
Ah, here for additional supplies for yourself, are you? Well, I can certainly understand the need for additional materiel... just take a look around if you need any proof. $B I'll issue you some additional supplies, but you'll need to give me an appropriate number of commendation signets in exchange. You won't receive any recognition for surrendering the signets in this manner, but you might find something useful that will help keep you alive when battle is finally upon us.
Alliance Commendation Signet ( 30 )
completion: Well then, it's settled; here are your supplies, $C . If you wish to do an additional exchange, then I am prepared to authorize it. Just give me the word and I'll make it happen. $B Keep up the good work, $N . We need all the materiel we can muster if we're going to win this thing. If we all do our part, then victory shall be ours for the taking!

8874.name: The Lunar Festival
desc: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the entrance to the Undercity. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
objectives: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the entrance to the Undercity. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
details: It's that time of the year, $N! The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival. You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight. She can tell you more about the holiday.
completion: Welcome, $N. Are you here to join in the festivities?

8898.name: Dearest Colara,
desc: Deliver the Creased Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
objectives: Deliver the Creased Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
details: I met a lass in Stormwind when I was last there on the bank's business. She stole my heart away. Now, I can't stop thinking about her! I'd like to send her this message - I've rewritten it twelve times!
The mail is so full now, and I want to make sure it gets there.
If you're heading that way, could you help me?
completion: Tormek? Oh yes, I do remember him. He had quite a nice beard and smile underneath.
Ah, I can't believe he remembered me!
progress: Hello there, handsome. Something I can help you with?

8922.name: A Supernatural Device
desc: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
objectives: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
details: I must find a way to speak with Anthion Harmon... or more specifically, his ghost!
I know of an engineer with a queer interest in the supernatural. He claims he can build a machine that allows him to speak with the dead!
The blood you collected was intended for him; travel to Gadgetzan and bring it to him as payment for his services!
completion: Excellent! Just as I was running low!
You say Deliana sent you?
progress: You've something for me?

8946.name: Proof of Life
desc: Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.
details: It is the cruelest of fates that my beloved has perished while trying to rescue me. Yet, you claim to possess the ability to converse with him.
Bring him this locket as proof that I am well. He must not linger in this world; my heart would not be able to bear it.
Farewell, $N. I shall be in your debt always.
completion: That locket... you found her! I can rest in peace at long last.
I shall now answer any questions you might have, $N. But make haste, my time in this world is not long.
progress: Ysida... is she alive?

8970.name: I See Alcaz Island In Your Future...
desc: Gather 20 Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga and then return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
objectives: Gather 20 Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga and then return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
details: As I was saying, $c, in my living years I flirted with becoming a diviner. But, there really wasn't as much profit in it as you might imagine, mostly because it's dangerous and the reagents are rare and expensive. However, I do know enough to be able to pinpoint the final piece of the amulet, and the spirit of my former comrade along with it.
This is where you come in, $N. I need you to go to Alcaz Island off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and collect Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga that live there.
completion: To be honest, $N, I'm surprised you made it back in one piece. Then again, I guess Alcaz Island is the least of your worries right now.
Ok, give me a moment here... divination isn't something that you can just snap your fingers and expect accurate answers from.
progress: Bloodkelp, $N, a big stack of it, that's what I need to power my divinatory spells. You're likely to need to take at least a couple of friends along with you to Alcaz Island to gather it up... those Strashaz are a nasty lot!

8994.name: Final Preparations
desc: Gather 40 Blackrock Bracers and acquire a Flask of Supreme Power. Return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
objectives: Gather 40 Blackrock Bracers and acquire a Flask of Supreme Power. Return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
details: We're nearly there, $c. All that is left is to retrieve a few more components so that I can attune the brazier and enable it to beckon forth Lord Valthalak.

To begin I must ask you to journey forth into Blackrock Spire and slay the orcs therein. They wear bracers that contain trace metals that I will need, so I'll need more than a few to extract the right amount out of them. Then, to complete the imbuing process, you'll need to bring me a Flask of Supreme Power.
Good luck, $N!
completion: That's it then. I'll extract the metal from the bracers and imbue the brazier with these final components. Then it will be ready for you to summon Lord Valthalak, and finally return his spirit amulet to him.
You've come quite a distance, $N, don't falter now that the end is in sight!
progress: We've come a long way, $N, and I just wanted to say that no matter what happens, thank you! You've put yourself in mortal danger to try to help the surviving members of our mercenary company, The Veiled Blade, and as far as I'm concerned, you're one of us now.

9018.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
objectives: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.
I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: This curse was bestowed upon us but for a mere medallion. Lord Valthalak certainly knows how to hold a grudge.
We'll endeavor to find the remaining pieces - hopefully before I meet an untimely demise. But before that, let us see about your reward.
progress: You've returned and I see in your eyes that you've much to tell me, $N.  Let us take care of your reward first.

9042.name: Dreadnaught Bracers
desc: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Bracers if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Bracers, 6 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 1 Nexus Crystal.
objectives: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Bracers if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Bracers, 6 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 1 Nexus Crystal.
details: During your battles with the Scourge in Naxxramas, should you come across desecrated battlements and wartorn plate scraps, return them to me and I shall craft for you a piece of armor worn by heroes.
progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
completion: Exellent $N !$B , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Dreadnaught Bracers.

9090.name: Dreamwalker Boots
desc: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreamwalker Boots if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Boots, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 2 Cured Rugged Hides.
objectives: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreamwalker Boots if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Boots, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 2 Cured Rugged Hides.
details: Many heroes fell in the last war and many continue to perish at the hands of the Scourge to this day. From the corpses of the fallen, the armor is stripped and taken back to Naxxramas to be used for unknown purposes.$B$BRecover the desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps and supply to me the other material components I require and I will craft Dreamwalker armor.
progress: The material cost is high, but soon forgotten.
completion: Your Dreamwalker Boots are ready, $N.

9114.name: Shoulderpads of Faith
desc: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Shoulderpads of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Shoulderpads, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.
objectives: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Shoulderpads of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Shoulderpads, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.
details: <Father Montoy makes some strange gestures in the air in front of you.>$B$BBlessed $g boy:girl;, have you found the vestments of the fallen? The poor souls whose last breaths were taken on the field of battle - stripped of everything including their dignity.$B$BBring me the desecrated remnants of the departed along with reagents of purification and you shall know faith.
progress: Have you brought me the reagents, child?
completion: The vestments are ready, $N. Smite those that would harm our world in your righteous fire.

9186.name: Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Belt
desc: Deliver 9 Wicked Leather Belts and the Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Belt - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Deliver 9 Wicked Leather Belts and the Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Belt - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.$B$BWork Order LW-736:$B$B9 Wicked Leather Belts.$B$BAll filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BContract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.$B$B-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
progress: Filling a work order, $C?
completion: These belts are actually more wicked than the headbands - if you can believe such a thing to be possible.

9210.name: The Savage Guard - Arcanum of Focus
desc: Zanza the Restless in Zul'Gurub wants an Arcanum of Focus.
objectives: Zanza the Restless in Zul'Gurub wants an Arcanum of Focus.
details: Zanza can create many ancient troll enchantments with proper components! Have you heard of the Savage Guard? No, of course you haven't. Your mind is addled with the inferior elven magic.$B$BBring me an arcanum of elven creation so that I may destroy the aberration. Do this and the Savage Guard will be yours.$B
progress: Do you have the arcanum?
completion: The worthless magic in these enchantments fuels my anger. My anger gives me strength.$B$BBring me more and you shall receive another Savage Guard.

9234.name: Icebane Gauntlets
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 12 Thorium Bars, 2 Arcanite Bars, 2 Essences of Water and 200 gold.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 12 Thorium Bars, 2 Arcanite Bars, 2 Essences of Water and 200 gold.
details: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create Icebane gauntlets. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!
progress: Have you brought the materials?

9330.name: Stealing Stormwind's Flame
desc: Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
details: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
completion: And this brightly-burning fire... you say it came from Stormwind? Remarkable! That must have been quite an adventure! I'll pay you for this, of course. If you find anything else like this, be sure to speak with me again.
progress: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?

9378.name: DND FLAG The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
desc: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.
objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.
details: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.

We have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! We will waive all cost associations.

65610.name: Wish You Were Here
details:
I met Krilge while making Mooncloth in Ashenvale. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared...

They've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it.

We would often meet at Fallen Sky Lake before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts.

I'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to Ashenvale and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.
progress: Yes, what is it?
completion: What is it you have there, $N ? A scarf made of... Mooncloth? You best not be seeking to romance me.

78090.name: A Second Opinion
details:
I'm not sure what to make of this orb, $N . I think we will need the help of... a specialist.

We are aware of a warlock sect operating out of Stormwind. Officially we reject the presence of warlocks in the city. Unofficially, their knowledge can be of use when dealing with demonic forces.

Find a representative of these warlocks, and seek their opinion on the orb.
progress: You're a long way from the cathedral, $C . I hope you realize you have no authority here.
completion: So the Silver Hand requires my aid? It will not come cheaply.

79242.name: No Honor Among Thieves
details:
As I was saying...

Our boss wasn't with the Horde. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds.

Once the Marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies.

I'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout somewhere near Arathi.
progress: <Using Illari's key, you unlock the cache.>
completion: <Inside of the cache, you find a small box, along with some coin.>

79362.name: Grant's Shield
objectives: Find Grant's Mace on one of the skeletons in Raven Hill Cemetery then return to Sirra Von'Indie in Darkshire for more information.

81954.name: Venomous Journeys
progress:
Have you brought something to add to our collection?
Venomous Journeys ( 1 )
completion: Thank you, $N . Our knowledge expands through your efforts. $B If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

84402.name: Necromancy 101
progress:
Have you brought something to add to our collection?
Necromancy 101 ( 1 )
completion: Thank you, $N . Our knowledge expands through your efforts. $B If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

92514.name: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
objectives: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.

92682.name: Make Yourself Useful
objectives: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.

92706.name: WANTED: Bruuz
objectives: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet.

92850.name: The Missing Scholar
objectives: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Fillion Flamebreeze in Valanaar.

94050.name: Training the Beast
objectives: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.

94434.name: A Lesson in Divinity
objectives: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
*Linen Cloth (10)
details: Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?
Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance.

Its my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
progress: I hope that this is no imposition upon you, goodly paladin.

95250.name: Abominable Creatures
objectives: Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.
*Head of the Baron
details: What do you want, ? Can't you see there is a war to be won?
My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.

95682.name: Open the Maw
objectives: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
* Dragonmaw Saboteur slain (2)
* Dragonmaw Warder slain (4)
* Dragonmaw Dispatch
details: Dragonmaw.
The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?
Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.
If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
progress: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.

97242.name: Yelmak's Medley
details: Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.
He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
objectives: Take some cuttings from the Cattails and Speargrass growing around the water flows in the Valley of Honor and return to Kor'geld in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.
*Handful of Cattails (2)
*Speargrass Cuttings (4)
completion: This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.
I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.
progress: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with it in their own way.
